title: Team
description: A team definition stored in teams/<assignment-id>/<team-slug>.json within a PXL Classroom control repository.

assignment_id.description: ID of the assignment this team belongs to.

team_slug.description: URL-safe slug uniquely identifying the team within the assignment.

team_name.description: Human-readable display name of the team.

members.description: GitHub logins of the students currently belonging to this team.

max_members.description: Maximum capacity of the team (from assignment group_config).

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the team was created.

created_by.description: GitHub login of the student or lecturer who created the team.

repo_name.description: Full or relative repository name for the team.

repo_id.description: Immutable GitHub repository ID of the provisioned team repo.

repo_url.description: HTTPS URL of the provisioned team repository.

vacant.description: True if all members have left or switched away from this team.

seeded_from.description: Provenance when this team was carried over from an earlier group assignment or the roster's team columns, rather than formed by students.

assignment_id.description: ID of the source assignment when source is 'assignment'.

assignment_title.description: Human-readable title of the source assignment, shown to students and lecturers.

seeded_by.description: GitHub login of the lecturer who ran the seed.
